meta.title: Home Value Estimator
meta.description: Estimate your home value using comparable sales, property details, and market data. Quick home valuation calculator for real estate agents.

title: Home Value Estimator
subtitle: Enter a property address to estimate its current market value based on recent comparable sales.
summary_fallback: We couldn’t find enough comparable sold data yet. Import MLS CSV sold history first.

result.range_note: Range reflects model confidence — not a formal appraisal.
result.no_comps: No comparable sales matched the current filters.
result.estimate_disclaimer: This is an automated estimate for planning purposes only, not an appraisal.
result.no_value_body: No comparable sales came back for this address, so there is nothing to base an estimate on. Check the spelling, or try a nearby address with recent sales.
